Wiry Build.description:
💪 Build: Wiry Build
Thin and tough — lean muscles stretched over a narrow frame. The kind of build that hides surprising strength behind an unassuming profile.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Wiry Build.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Wiry frame — thin but visibly strong, ropy muscle visible under the skin at forearms and neck. Tendons pronounced, body taut and spring-loaded. Female: shoulders narrow with visible tendon, slim corded neck, fine jaw, a slight chest line over a tight waist. Male: shoulders narrow and ropy, corded neck, sharp jaw, a flat chest on a ropy torso. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure thin and strong.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
